interface.name: wana_shell_control_v1

description.summary: private compositor to shell control channel

interface.description: This interface is advertised only to the compositor-started Wana shell. It carries desktop policy actions from the compositor to the shell. Public application clients must never see or bind this global.

event.name: toggle_launcher
event.description: Emitted when the compositor recognizes the configured launcher key.
